_help: Day 2, room 4: the living room, 'Margot' (1963-1981). Margot's beads under the rug, her story-time lamp rules, her teddy for Chloé's nose, Papa's Sunday records. See docs/STORY.md.

locks._why: The garden doors' key was behind Papa's records.
hints: The garden is waiting; the glass doors are locked.
The key from the record sleeves opens the garden doors.
Select the brass key, then tap the garden doors.

locks._why: Margot's bead box slid under the rug; Chloé wriggles in.
hints: Something small went under the flying carpet.
Chloé can wriggle under the rug.
Tap Chloé, then tap the rug.

locks._why: Margot's necklace: one shell, then one more star each time (1, 2, 3 stars).
hints: A necklace with a rule. What changes each time?
After every shell there is one more star than before.

locks._why: Reading lamp on (sun); stars off while Papa reads; shells on whenever the sun is; the sea on only when the stars are off: sun, shell and wave on, star off.
hints: Story time needs the right lamps. Who wrote the rules?
Margot's story-time rules are about the lamp panel by the garden doors.
Sun on, shell on, star off, wave on.

locks._why: Margot's hiding place smells of her teddy; Chloé follows the scent to the books.
hints: Something of Margot's still smells of her.
Select the teddy, then tap Chloé.

locks._why: The dancing one (stars) last; sun right after the sea; the love song never first: wave, sun, heart, star.
hints: Papa always played them the same way on Sundays.
Margot's note from her hiding place is about the record sleeves.
